svg.title: The nonabelian simple algebra has positive dimension and b0 > 0, so the coefficient is positive. These are the physical-stress and Wilson-calibrated running-charge conventions. Translation and orthogonal invariance reduce every separated trace pair to E at its Euclidean distance. An orthog- onal reflection takes their difference to a time-axis vector of the same norm; a common translation then puts them at the opposed points above. Degree-four scaling identifies the rescaled trace with 4d2 times the free scalar label after logarithmic running normalization. The scalar Wick contraction is 3 dim g/(π4|x0 −x1|8). Multiplying by running factor b−2 0 /4 and trace factor (4d2)2 gives exactly AG|x0 −x1|−8 on the extracted radii and nearby generic plots. The positive spectral representation
